justification: Inspected `javaparser-core-generators/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/generator/core/visitor/*.java` (15 classes, 1037 LOC total) plus the shared `javaparser-core-generators/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/generator/VisitorGenerator.java`. The package is a cohesive set of narrow generators: each class extends `VisitorGenerator` and specializes one visitor variant (`GenericVisitorGenerator.java`, `VoidVisitorGenerator.java`, `CloneVisitorGenerator.java`, `HashCodeVisitorGenerator.java`, `ModifierVisitorGenerator.java`, `NoCommentEqualsVisitorGenerator.java`, etc.) rather than concentrating unrelated responsibilities in one package.
